Test Case Title: Standard user can sign in successfully
Preconditions: SauceDemo is reachable; browser context is fresh.
Test Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter standard_user and secret_sauce. 3. Select Login.
Expected Results: Browser navigates to /inventory.html; Products heading and inventory cards are visible.

Test Case Title: Locked-out user receives a clear authentication error
Preconditions: SauceDemo is reachable; browser context is fresh.
Test Steps: 1. Open login. 2. Enter locked_out_user and secret_sauce. 3. Select Login.
Expected Results: Login is rejected and a visible error explains that the user is locked out.

Test Case Title: Inventory page renders the expected products
Preconditions: The standard demo user is available.
Test Steps: 1. Sign in using the authenticatedShopper fixture. 2. Wait for Products and inventory cards. 3. Read product names.
Expected Results: Six inventory products are rendered and Sauce Labs Backpack is present.

Test Case Title: Products can be sorted by price from low to high
Preconditions: Authenticated user is on Inventory.
Test Steps: 1. Select Price (low to high). 2. Read displayed prices in order. 3. Verify ascending numerical order and lowest-priced product.
Expected Results: Prices are ascending and Sauce Labs Onesie is first.

Test Case Title: Adding a product updates the cart badge
Preconditions: Authenticated user is on Inventory with an empty cart.
Test Steps: 1. Add Sauce Labs Backpack. 2. Check the cart badge. 3. Verify the product action changes to Remove.
Expected Results: Badge displays 1 and the Backpack action changes to Remove.

Test Case Title: A product can be removed from the cart
Preconditions: Authenticated user can add a product.
Test Steps: 1. Add Sauce Labs Backpack. 2. Open Cart. 3. Remove the Backpack. 4. Check cart contents and badge.
Expected Results: Backpack is absent from Cart and the empty-cart badge is removed.

Test Case Title: Shopper completes checkout for a cart prepared by a fixture
Preconditions: The standard user can sign in; checkout fixture can establish a cart.
Test Steps: 1. Fixture signs in and adds Backpack. 2. Open checkout. 3. Enter customer details. 4. Verify overview and subtotal. 5. Finish the order.
Expected Results: Overview includes Backpack and $29.99 subtotal; completion page displays “Thank you for your order!”.

Test Case Title: Invalid username and password are rejected
Preconditions: Login page is open.
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid_user and not_the_password. 2. Select Login. 3. Verify the error and URL.
Expected Results: Generic invalid-credentials error is visible and Inventory is not opened.

Test Case Title: Empty username displays required-field validation
Preconditions: Login page is open.
Test Steps: 1. Leave username blank. 2. Enter a valid password. 3. Select Login.
Expected Results: Login is blocked and “Username is required” is displayed.

Test Case Title: Empty password displays required-field validation
Preconditions: Login page is open.
Test Steps: 1. Enter a valid username. 2. Leave password blank. 3. Select Login.
Expected Results: Login is blocked and “Password is required” is displayed.

Test Case Title: Products can be sorted by name A to Z
Preconditions: Authenticated user is on Inventory.
Test Steps: 1. Select Name (A to Z). 2. Read displayed product names. 3. Compare to alphabetically ascending order.
Expected Results: Displayed product names are in ascending alphabetical order.

Test Case Title: Products can be sorted by name Z to A
Preconditions: Authenticated user is on Inventory.
Test Steps: 1. Select Name (Z to A). 2. Read displayed product names. 3. Compare to alphabetically descending order.
Expected Results: Displayed product names are in descending alphabetical order.

Test Case Title: Products can be sorted by price from high to low
Preconditions: Authenticated user is on Inventory.
Test Steps: 1. Select Price (high to low). 2. Read displayed prices. 3. Verify descending numerical order.
Expected Results: Displayed prices are sorted in descending numerical order.

Test Case Title: Cart shows the correct contents when multiple products are added
Preconditions: Authenticated user is on Inventory with an empty cart.
Test Steps: 1. Add Sauce Labs Backpack. 2. Add Sauce Labs Bike Light. 3. Verify badge count. 4. Open Cart and verify both products and item count.
Expected Results: Badge displays 2; Cart contains exactly Backpack and Bike Light.

Test Case Title: Checkout blocks continuation when postal code is missing
Preconditions: Authenticated user has Backpack in Cart and opens checkout information.
Test Steps: 1. Leave postal code blank while entering first and last names. 2. Select Continue. 3. Check validation and URL.
Expected Results: Postal Code is required is displayed and user remains on checkout-step-one.html.

Test Case Title: Submitting a completely empty login form displays validation
Preconditions: User is logged out and login page is open.
Test Steps: 1. Leave both username and password empty. 2. Click Login. 3. Observe the validation message.
Expected Results: Login is blocked and username-required validation appears.

Test Case Title: Product detail page presents the selected product information
Preconditions: Standard user is signed in and Inventory is visible.
Test Steps: 1. Open the Backpack details from its title. 2. Verify name, description, price and button. 3. Return to Inventory.
Expected Results: Details correspond to Backpack, show a non-empty description and $29.99 price, and provide a working add/remove action.

Test Case Title: Continue Shopping returns to Inventory without losing cart item
Preconditions: Standard user is signed in and one product is in Cart.
Test Steps: 1. Open Cart. 2. Click Continue Shopping. 3. Verify Inventory. 4. Reopen Cart.
Expected Results: User returns to Inventory and the existing cart item remains.

Test Case Title: Logout prevents access to protected Inventory page
Preconditions: User is signed in and Inventory is visible.
Test Steps: 1. Open the side menu. 2. Click Logout. 3. Navigate directly to /inventory.html. 4. Verify protected content is not shown.
Expected Results: User is logged out; direct navigation to Inventory redirects to or displays the login state.

Test Case Title: Cart contents remain consistent across Inventory and Cart navigation
Preconditions: User is signed in and cart starts empty.
Test Steps: 1. Add Backpack and Bike Light. 2. Open Cart and record both entries. 3. Continue shopping. 4. Open Cart again.
Expected Results: Both products remain in Cart and count stays at two after navigation.

Test Case Title: Checkout requires a first name
Preconditions: User is signed in, cart is non-empty and checkout information page is open.
Test Steps: 1. Leave First Name blank. 2. Fill last name and postal code. 3. Click Continue.
Test Data: First name blank; last name Tester; postal code 500001
Expected Results: Checkout stays on the information page and displays a first-name-required error.

Test Case Title: Checkout requires a last name
Preconditions: User is signed in, cart is non-empty and checkout information page is open.
Test Steps: 1. Fill first name and postal code. 2. Leave Last Name blank. 3. Click Continue.
Test Data: First name Alex; last name blank; postal code 500001
Expected Results: Checkout stays on the information page and displays a last-name-required error.

Test Case Title: Cancel from checkout information returns to Cart
Preconditions: User is signed in and has at least one cart item.
Test Steps: 1. Open Cart. 2. Click Checkout. 3. Click Cancel on the information page. 4. Verify destination and cart item.
Expected Results: User returns to Cart and previously added item remains.

Test Case Title: Cancel from checkout overview returns to shopping
Preconditions: User has a product in Cart and valid customer details are entered.
Test Steps: 1. Continue from checkout information to overview. 2. Click Cancel. 3. Verify destination and cart state.
Expected Results: Checkout is cancelled and user returns to Inventory without placing an order.

Test Case Title: Checkout subtotal, tax and total are calculated correctly
Preconditions: User is signed in and can reach checkout overview with known products.
Test Steps: 1. Add Backpack and Bike Light. 2. Complete customer information. 3. On overview, calculate subtotal and verify tax and total.
Expected Results: Displayed subtotal is $39.98; displayed tax and total match the application's rounding and tax rules.

Test Case Title: Back Home after order confirmation returns to Inventory
Preconditions: A demo checkout has been completed.
Test Steps: 1. On the confirmation page, click Back Home. 2. Verify Inventory. 3. Inspect the cart badge and product actions.
Expected Results: User returns to Inventory and completed cart state is cleared.

Test Case Title: Side-menu All Items navigates to Inventory
Preconditions: User is signed in and any non-checkout page is open.
Test Steps: 1. Open the side menu. 2. Select All Items. 3. Verify URL and Products heading.
Expected Results: Inventory is displayed and user can continue shopping.

Test Case Title: About menu opens the expected external destination
Preconditions: User is signed in and the side menu is available.
Test Steps: 1. Open the side menu. 2. Select About. 3. Verify the destination opened and page loads.
Expected Results: A Sauce Labs destination opens successfully; no broken or unexpected internal page is shown.

Test Case Title: Reset App State clears cart state on Inventory
Preconditions: User is signed in and at least one product has been added.
Test Steps: 1. Open the side menu. 2. Select Reset App State. 3. Close menu. 4. Check cart badge and affected product button.
Expected Results: Cart badge is cleared and product action returns to Add to cart.

Test Case Title: Browser Back from product details returns to the catalog
Preconditions: User is signed in and Inventory is visible.
Test Steps: 1. Open a product detail page. 2. Use browser Back. 3. Verify Inventory list and sort control.
Expected Results: Inventory returns with product cards visible and navigation remains usable.

Test Case Title: All inventory product images render successfully
Preconditions: User is signed in and Inventory is loaded.
Test Steps: 1. Inspect each product card image. 2. Verify each image is visible and not broken. 3. Check image content corresponds to the product.
Expected Results: Every product card image renders without broken-image placeholders.

Test Case Title: Product data matches between catalog and detail page
Preconditions: User is signed in and Inventory is visible.
Test Steps: 1. Record a product name, description and price from the catalog. 2. Open its detail page. 3. Compare displayed information.
Test Data: Sauce Labs Backpack and one other product
Expected Results: Name and price match between pages; description is present and belongs to the selected product.

Test Case Title: Keyboard navigation follows a usable focus order
Preconditions: Login page is open, then repeat the check on Inventory.
Test Steps: 1. Use Tab and Shift+Tab without a mouse. 2. Observe focus order and visible focus indicators. 3. Activate Login or a product action using the keyboard.
Expected Results: Focusable controls follow a logical order, focus is visible and key actions can be activated.

Test Case Title: Responsive layout remains usable at a mobile viewport
Preconditions: Browser viewport can be set to a common mobile size.
Test Steps: 1. Set viewport to 390x844. 2. Open Login and sign in. 3. Inspect Inventory, Cart and Checkout. 4. Look for horizontal overflow or overlapping controls.
Expected Results: Primary actions and text remain visible and usable without unintended horizontal scrolling or overlap.

Test Case Title: Refreshing Inventory preserves authenticated navigation and cart state
Preconditions: User is signed in and one product is in Cart.
Test Steps: 1. Add Backpack. 2. Refresh the Inventory page. 3. Verify the authenticated page loads. 4. Open Cart and inspect the item.
Expected Results: Page refresh does not leave a broken route; expected signed-in and cart behavior is observed and documented.
